parameters.content:
## BLM - 5. Router de Eventos

Webhook path: `blm/events`
`N8N_WEBHOOK_URL=https://aldeia-n8n.giuxk6.easypanel.host/webhook/blm/events`

Eventos manejados:
- `lead.created` ? email al comprador + email al dealer
- `custom_request.created` ? email confirmaci�n al solicitante
- `search_alert.created` ? email confirmaci�n de alerta
- `vehicle.approved` ? email al dealer
- `vehicle.rejected` ? email al dealer con motivo

Requerido: `RESEND_API_KEY, MAIL_FROM, MARKET_URL`
Opcional: `N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET` para verificar origen
